name: Plug Puller, one-sided puller
author: Brennen Johnston
description: A 3D-printed tool that pulls a wall plug with your whole hand instead of a fingertip pinch, shaped to your plug and your hand. For a plug up to 24 mm thick: a pocket around the plug's back and sides with two finger holes below it. Fill in Step 1 to Step 4; everything else is optional.
